notes.title: [Playtest 0.0.8] Hotfix
notes.content: [h1]V0.0.8[/h1][h3]MANAGEMENT[/h3][list][*][p]A major bug causing a return to the main menu at the end of a match has been fixed. (Thanks @AgentPurple!)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: [Playtest - 0.0.6] Bugfixes & Match settings
notes.content:
[h1]V0.0.6[/h1]
[h2]MANAGEMENT[/h2]
[list]
[*]It's now possible to choose different settings when creating a game, including the number of rounds.
[*]Fixed a bug where dialog options are not displayed.
[*]Fixed a bug where it was always the same teams registered for tournaments.
[*]Fixed a bug where tournaments images were not loaded.
[*]Fixed a bug where old tournaments were displayed in the Home page.
[*]Added some tournaments logos.
[*]Shanghai Major has been moved to a later date.
[/list]

[h2]SIMULATION:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added an "Auto-buy" button in the buying menu of each player.
[*]Added a "Surrender" button to leave a match early.
[*]Added a button to randomly select a tactic.
[/list]

notes.title: [Playtest - 0.0.5] New 3D simulation !
notes.content:
A new 3D simulation engine has arrived! For the moment, only one map, de_cache, uses this new simulation, but other maps will be added with each update.

This new simulation will significantly improve the game, allowing features such as smoke grenades or flashbangs to be added in future updates.

I need your help! Report any bugs you come across and suggest ideas for improvements on the [url=https://discord.gg/eBMwWRqSFT]Discord server[/url].

[i]A new wave of player access to the Playtest has also been opened.[/i]

[h1]V0.0.5:[/h1]
[h2]MANAGEMENT:[/h2]
[list]
[*]The Demo end date has been removed. Tournaments are cyclical and are created every year.
[*]Added 20 new tournaments.
[*]Ranking points awarded now depend on tournament size.
[*]Tournament registration is now open one day, 7 days before the start of the tournament. The fast-forwarding of days is stopped if tournament registration is possible.
[*]AI teams are added to tournaments if they are not fully booked at launch.
[*]It is now possible to sign contract extension for players nearing the end of their contract.
[*]Fixed ranking list.
[*]Fixed a bug when Tournament page is selected.
[*]Added a new training schedule.
[*]Fixed typos.
[/list]
[h2]SIMULATION:[/h2]
[list]
[*]3D Simulation has been added to the game. 2D simulation will remain in the game for existing maps until they are converted. New maps will be created in 3D.
[*]Added de_cache (3D)
[*]Fixed a bug where players with low skills would shoot infinitely.
[*]Overall player accuracy has been reduced. It still depends on weapon skill and aim value.
[/list]
[h2]OTHER:[/h2]
[list]
[*]The game has been updated to Unity 6
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922982/a352ba8f2478608c9e5ac39b4e3c5a592cfb7cb2.png[/img]

notes.title: [Playtest - 0.0.3] Scouting, Mirage and new buying menu
notes.content:
This patch focuses mainly on fixing the bugs you've reported on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FeBMwWRqSFT]Discord server[/url], as well as adding a few new features. A new map, de_mirage, has been added. New maps will be added with each update. Don't hesitate to suggest new tactics you'd like to see added to the game on the Discord server.
The development roadmap will be based mainly on your feedback, so don't hesitate to express your views on the missing features that you feel are most important.

[i]A new wave of player access to the Playtest has also been opened.[/i]

[h1]V0.0.3:[/h1]

[h2]MANAGEMENT[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scouting has been added to the game.
[*] Settings page has been reworked.
[*] kRaSnaL got his polish nationality back.
[*] Fixed money rewards for Double Elimination tournaments.
[*] Fixed displayed match number in League Tournaments
[*] Fixed a bug where it was possible to register for a tournament for which the team had already qualified.
[*] Fixed home page ranking list for modded games.
[*] Fixed missing map name for last matches statistics in player page.
[*] Fixed some UI display issues on Home page
[/list]

[h2]SIMULATION:[/h2]
[list]
[*] de_mirage has been added.
[*] Buying menu has been added to the game.
[*] Players no longer buy the most expensive weapon available.
[*] Fixed a bug where AI team eco on last round before halftime.
[*] Fixes some weapons icons.
[*] Player speed and field of view have been increased
[*] Added some visual effects for bullets
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922982/9ec041dd2db3bb9604f0480c5c591ee358308153.png[/img]
[i]Mirage is the third map to be added to the game ![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922982/2890a7d253991adbb7d60bb11e332996c38fdb0c.png[/img]
[i]Player scouting is now recommended in order to obtain more information on stats and market value.[/i]

[h2]OTHER:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a corrupted save bug.
[*] Added resolution settings.
[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Loading a save file from the Settings menu can block match launch. Reload your saves from the main menu.
[*] The visual effect of the bullets may be blocked by walls, but the shots are still effective.
[/list]

notes.title: [Playtest - 0.0.2] Bugfixes, Inferno and new Discord server
notes.content:
[h1]The Discord server is now open![/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/eBMwWRqSFT]Join us here[/url] to keep up to date with future updates, report bugs or suggest improvements.

[h1]V0.0.2:[/h1]

This patch focuses mainly on fixing the bugs you've reported on the Steam forum, as well as adding a few new features. A new map, de_inferno, has also been added. New maps will be added with each update. Don't hesitate to suggest new tactics you'd like to see added to the game on the Discord server.
The development roadmap will be based mainly on your feedback, so don't hesitate to express your views on the missing features that you feel are most important.

[i]A new wave of player access to the Playtest has also been opened.[/i]

[h2]MANAGEMENT:[/h2]
[list]
[*]It is now possible to skip days until the next required player action.
[*]End-of-match statistics display the player's accuracy.
[*]Fixed LEAGUE tournaments.
[*]Players now leave the team when their contract expires.
[*]Fixes a bug in the "Talk" page when the team has no players.
[*]Balances some starting money values.
[*]Fixed a bug where AI teams could not recruit new players.
[*]Fixed the Win Rate value.
[*]Fixed end-of-match statistics in auto-play mode to be more realistic.
[*]Fixed corrupted saves.
[/list]

[h2]SIMULATION:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added de_inferno.
[*]It is now possible to speed up or slow down the simulation.
[*]Player accuracy now depends on their skill with the equipped weapon and their AIM skill value.
[*]Players can be selected to display information and zoom the camera. To return to the global view, click on the button below the minimap.
[*]Players nicknames are now displayed
[*]The overall sound volume of the game has been reduced. Each weapon now has its own volume. Bomb beeps increase in volume the closer you get to the explosion.
[*]Players now have multiple messages for each situation.
[*]Dust2 hitboxes have been fixed and players can no longer see and shoot through doors.
[*]Fixed a bug where the CT would not defuse the bomb if he has been interrupted during an initial defusing. Same with Ts planting bomb.
[*]Fixed a bug where 2 CTs would defuse the bomb at the same time.
[*]Fixed a bug where player messages were spammed.
[*]Fixed bomb defuse sound.
[*]Fixed a bug where players would not react to the death of an ally near them.
[/list]

Thank you!

evergnault
